name: browser-use
headline: convert documents to epub with claude skill
short_description: Converts markdown documents, chat summaries, or research reports into downloadable EPUB files. Ideal for operations teams to create portable ebooks for distribution via Kindle or other devices. Integrates with Claude agents to automate document conversion workflows.
author: smerchek

sections.overview:
This skill transforms markdown content into EPUB3 format ebooks that work across all major reading platforms including Apple Books, Amazon Kindle, Google Play Books, and Kobo. It automatically detects chapters from H1 headers, preserves markdown formatting (bold, italic, links, lists, code blocks, tables), and generates a proper table of contents with navigation. The skill accepts raw markdown text or file paths, extracts metadata from YAML frontmatter, and produces device-agnostic ebooks suitable for research documents, blog posts, articles, and conversation summaries. Operations teams use it to create portable ebooks for distribution without manual formatting.
Convert research reports and technical documentation to shareable EPUB ebooks
Transform chat summaries and meeting notes into formatted ebook chapters
Generate portable ebooks from blog posts and articles for Kindle distribution
Automate batch conversion of markdown files into professional ebook format
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/smerchek/claude-epub-skill`
sections.usage:
```
Convert the markdown document [MARKDOWN_FILE_PATH] into a downloadable EPUB file named [OUTPUT_FILENAME].epub. Ensure the EPUB is formatted for readability on Kindle devices, with proper chapter breaks, a table of contents, and consistent styling. If the document includes images or diagrams, embed them directly in the EPUB. Provide the download link once the conversion is complete.
```
Copy

```
Your document 'project_roadmap_2024.md' has been successfully converted to 'project_roadmap_2024.epub'. The EPUB includes:

- A structured table of contents with clickable links to each section.
- Three chapters: Introduction, Key Milestones, and Next Steps.
- Embedded diagrams from the original markdown file, formatted for Kindle display.
- Consistent styling with a clean, readable font (EB Garamond) and proper spacing.

The file is optimized for Kindle devices and can be downloaded here:
[Download project_roadmap_2024.epub](https://storage.example.com/project_roadmap_2024.epub)

Note: If you encounter formatting issues on your Kindle, try adjusting the font size in your device settings or re-downloading the file. For best results, use the Kindle app on mobile or desktop.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
